main_idea: A simple prompt cuts clutter scores from high raw levels to near zero.
ideas: Simple prompt cuts clutter to near zero
Raw prompts leave substantial clutter across models
Clutter score is lower for simple prompts
summary: Clean and nearly free of clutter, but the bars are misaligned with their model labels and tick marks, so the chart cannot be read reliably.
defects: Model row labels do not line up with their bars; reader cannot tell which bar belongs to which model
Y-axis percentage ticks (60, 45, 30, 15, 0) do not match the model rows
Simple-prompt bars start at a different x-origin than raw-prompt bars
Two raw-prompt bars for one model stack and overlap vertically
X-axis 0 to 80 scale has no unit label
Value labels sit beside the wrong rows in places, such as 46% and 42%
